name: Student Residence Permit (Third-Country National)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires enrolment in a full-time, complete study cycle at a Luxembourg higher-education establishment, leading to an academic degree or diploma.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission from a Luxembourg higher-education institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Monthly resources must be at least 80% of the current social inclusion income (REVIS). Scholarship, student loan, bank certificates, sponsor financial-support statements, up to 15 hours/week of work income, and free housing all count toward this.
Must hold a health insurance certificate covering illness in Luxembourg at the time of the initial application.

evidence_required.document: Admission letter for a full-time degree program
Proof of resources (scholarship, loan, bank statements, or sponsor support letter)

outcome.duration_length: minimum 1 year or the duration of the study cycle if shorter, renewable while conditions are met

sources.title: Guichet.lu -- Conditions for Residence in Luxembourg for Students from Third Countries: 80% of REVIS financial-resources standard, health insurance, up to 15 hours/week work rights during study

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Luxembourg). work_rights modeled 'restricted' reflecting the 15-hour/week cap that also functions as a partial income source counted toward the financial-resources test. family_can_join modeled false: no student-specific family reunification provision was located in this pass.
